svg.title: XENA LaaS — Functional View v2
svg.desc: Corrected functional architecture. XENALoader enqueues to SQS grid-queue; GRIDConnector dequeues independently. OutputHandler Lambda contains StatusTracker and ResultHandler. ProgressTracker is Redis ElastiCache. ErrorHandler is a Lambda. Observability via GETAFE (Openshift).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the upstream service send to XENA?')
sendPrompt('How does the result consumer read XENA output?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in the XENA S3 input bucket?')
sendPrompt('What ends up in the xena-error bucket?')
sendPrompt('How does the SQS main-queue receive S3 events?')
sendPrompt('What are the internal modules of XENALoader?')
sendPrompt('Why does XENA use a separate SQS grid-queue between XENALoader and GRIDConnector?')
sendPrompt('What does GRIDConnector do after dequeuing from grid-queue?')
sendPrompt('How does Redis ElastiCache serve as the ProgressTracker in XENA?')
sendPrompt('What does the ErrorHandler Lambda do in XENA?')
sendPrompt('How does the GRID runtime execute a library container?')
sendPrompt('What does XDE resolve in the GRID compute plane?')
sendPrompt('How are library containers version-pinned in XENA?')
sendPrompt('How is a new library onboarded as plug-and-play?')
sendPrompt('What does OutputHandler Lambda do — StatusTracker and ResultHandler?')
sendPrompt('What is GETAFE Openshift and how does it serve XENA observability?')
sendPrompt('What does Kafka stream in XENA observability?')
sendPrompt('What Kibana dashboards does XENA expose?')
